title: Exact simulator launch key v1
description: Exact sm_86 launch identity. kernel_mangled_name, grid, block, device_id, stream_id, and binary_architecture are replay-visible assertions that must match authenticated trace evidence. workload_id, matched_execution_id, and process_launch_ordinal are cohort assertions and become claimable only through an independently sealed matched-label/crosswalk exact join.

workload_id.description: Cohort assertion; not authenticated by trace evidence.

matched_execution_id.description: Cohort assertion binding independently matched trace and label executions.

process_launch_ordinal.description: Cohort assertion within the independently matched process execution.

kernel_mangled_name.description: Replay-visible identity; must equal authenticated trace evidence.

grid.description: Replay-visible geometry; must equal authenticated trace evidence.

block.description: Replay-visible geometry; must equal authenticated trace evidence.

device_id.description: Replay-visible identity; must equal authenticated trace evidence.

stream_id.description: Replay-visible identity; must equal authenticated trace evidence.

binary_architecture.description: Replay-visible architecture; must equal authenticated trace evidence.
